entries.proposition: Model scope: the low-dose pentylenetetrazol arm uses non-epileptic rats with no baseline spike-wave discharges, in which a provoked electrographic spike-wave response is generated and measured, a pharmacological model without a genotype; the second is a genetic absence strain (WAG/Rij). No genotype comparison with a drug exists in the paper.
entries.snippet: No spontaneous SWDs were recorded in these series of animals, and all the rats were included for further experiments.
entries.anchor: Results, STP inhibits SWDs in the low-dose PTZ model

entries.proposition: A low-dose PTZ spike-wave response in non-epileptic (wild-type) rats is suppressed by a drug that the paper reports also inhibits T-type channels, i.e. a PTZ-provoked response in animals without the mutation can be pharmacologically suppressed, and the response itself is sustained for about 40 min and then declines rapidly.
entries.snippet: STP administered before PTZ (20 mg/kg ip) almost completely abolished the generation of SWD at the maximal dose of 300 mg/kg (Figure 1B,C).
entries.anchor: Results, STP inhibits SWDs in the low-dose PTZ model (the numeric doses are the paper's rat protocol and are not carried into any recommendation)

entries.proposition: The compound blocks the three human T-type isoforms with IC50 values of about 37 to 69 micromolar (Cav3.3 most), and the blocking was defined from three cells per concentration. The authors argue the concentrations are in the range reported in plasma at therapeutic exposure; they did not measure brain concentrations, receptor occupancy or region selectivity.
entries.snippet: The IC50 values were determined to be 69.16 μmol·L–1 for CaV3.1 (Hill coefficient = 1.71), 64.35 μmol·L–1 for CaV3.2 (Hill coefficient = 1.68), and 36.6 μmol·L–1 for Cav 3.3 (Hill coefficient = 1.19).
entries.anchor: Results, STP inhibits voltage-dependent calcium channels in vitro

entries.proposition: The authors cannot separate T-type block from GABA-A alpha3 modulation in vivo (local intracerebral injection is not feasible for the compound) and conclude only that both could be involved. The T-type mechanism is therefore a correlation of in-vitro IC50 with in-vivo efficacy, not a demonstration.
entries.snippet: Therefore, the respective involvement of GABAergic alpha3 subunit‐containing receptors and of low‐threshold calcium channel modulation is difficult to assess

entries.proposition: The authors report that administration of the compound 15 minutes before the delta-subunit GABA-A agonist completely blocked the agonist's effect on spike-and-wave discharges and still displayed antiabsence properties.
entries.snippet: STP administration 15 min before THIP completely blocked THIP effect on SWDs, and still displayed antiabsence properties
entries.anchor: Results, STP inhibits SWDs aggravated after administration of THIP in WAG/Rij rats
